notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*]Added Korean text to the game’s supported languages[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Updated the "Base Camp Chatter" function in the Options menu, allowing the frequency of voice lines to be adjusted between "Frequent," "Moderate," and "None."
[*] Fixed a bug with the Crooked Crab boss where it would remain outside the player's range on rare occasions.[/list]
